mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to be negative due to higher real borrowing costs compressing equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > (current value + 0.25%) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the specified FEDFUNDS rise, or FEDFUNDS increase < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor market additions) of at least 50,000 jobs over the next 60 days is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return due to stronger labor demand and optimism in corporate hiring.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > (current value + 50,000) over the next 2 months
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS increases by ≥50,000 jobs, or the effect is explained by other variables.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (real private demand) grows faster than CPIAUCSL (inflation) over the next 20 days, the S&P 500 forward return is predicted to be positive, reflecting outpacing inflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > CPIAUCSL growth rate over next 20 days
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the condition holds, or the effect is not statistically significant after controlling for inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of at least 5 points over the next 5 days predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return as it signals weak manufacturing momentum and reduced economic momentum for equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the INDPRO decline, or the decline is not observed.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS > 4%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to persistent tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in this regime, or the regime definition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE drop below 4% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days as lower unemployment expectations boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4%, or the effect is spurious.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (household spending) rises by at least 2% over the next 20 days, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is predicted to be positive, reflecting stronger consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: No significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) during the specified HOUST increase, or the increase is not observed.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both INDPRO and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 3 points over the next 5 days predicts a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to dual supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < (current value - 3) AND RSAFS < (current value - 3) over next 5 days
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both indicators decline by ≥3, or the interaction is not statistically significant.
